environment.description: Migration script runs in an ECS Fargate task behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a fixed-response action rule that appends response headers via a Lambda@Edge-equivalent mechanism (ALB action type 'fixed-response' is NOT used; instead, the target group health check path is /health). The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs at /data. The ALB listener has a response header injection rule configured via the 'aws:elb:listener:headers' attribute adding 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; style-src \'self\'' to ALL responses proxied through the ALB on port 443. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with awsvpc networking mode; the task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 8080. No direct access to the container port is possible from outside the VPC.

config.signal_isolation: Fargate tasks have isolated PID namespaces per task
